title: MCP numeric parser used POSIX-only strndup in Windows driver

Replaced with checked malloc/memcpy/NUL, preserving bytes/lifetime; strict and final30 native/sanitizer/recorded tests pass. Source-audit issue; MSVC runtime unavailable.
